title: Worked example: the published result cannot be reproduced

metadata.purpose: Synthetic data demonstrating the reproduction gate firing. The study rows pool to about 0.74, not the 0.30 this record claims was published, so ReMeta refuses to issue a verdict and reports UNVERIFIED. Not real trial data.
metadata.why_it_matters: A recalculation you cannot anchor to the published result is a different analysis wearing the same name. The mismatch is a verification problem to investigate in the input data, not a finding about the review.
